note: Set B binds the key quantities more faithfully: it correctly reports the 97:1 gearbox ratio, the 0.0255764 N·m/rpm² Region 2 constant (in one claim with the right unit), the 6.9 rpm minimum rotor speed as a rotor (not generator) property, and the peak Cp of 0.482 at TSR 7.55, 0.0° pitch, 8 m/s. Set A introduces clear misreads and misbindings: 97.1:1 instead of 97:1, rated mechanical power 5.298610 MW instead of 5.296610 MW, an invented rated speed of 1.963 rpm, the rotor's 6.9 rpm bound to the generator, the fourth-order state-space note bound to the baseline filter (it applies to the alternative filters considered), and a quote with fabricated '[missing]' text, plus heavy duplication. B's weaknesses are a wrong unit (Nm/rpm) on one constant claim, two claims that drop 'filtered' from the speed relationship, and omission of the rated mechanical power (5.296610 MW) and rated generator speed (1173.7 rpm) that A does capture. On balance B has more unique correct claims and far fewer substantive errors.
